agent.problem: The earlier cards say only that the LORD lifted David up and that David cried for help. They give no basis for choosing “healed” over “crowned” or “armed,” so the blank asks for unseen wording rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
